Definition: to swallow greedily; causatively, to feed
BiblicalUsage: To swallow greedily appears once, and it is Esau's hunger in Genesis 25:30: "Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint." The word is the gulp of a starving man, and it cost Esau his birthright.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that the verse is the whole story of appetite in one gulp: Esau swallowed the pottage and lost the blessing, and I have done the same with cheaper things.
